legal.label: Legal
legal.title: The exact clause, in seconds
legal.description: Query contracts, case files and regulatory filings in plain language. Every answer points to the clause and page that back it.
problems: An auto-renewal clause slips through unnoticed
Comparing amendments version by version takes hours
A generic assistant cites no clause or page
benefits: Contradictions and risky clauses surfaced before a counterparty does
Review the whole matter in minutes, not days
Every answer cites the exact clause and page
security: Access controlled by matter, client and role
Confidentiality preserved: model is never trained on your documents
Deploy in our EU cloud or entirely in your own perimeter

faq.question: Can Prosperify review a whole data room at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Upload a data room, ask about any clause, party or obligation, and every answer cites its clause and page.

faq.question: How does it handle confidentiality for legal teams?
faq.answer: Access is scoped by matter, client and role, and the model is never trained on your documents. You can deploy it in your own cloud or perimeter.

faq.question: Does it flag contradictions between related documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It cross-references amendments and versions and surfaces contradictions so you can resolve them before a counterparty raises them.

legal.sample_question: Which supplier contracts renew automatically before Q2, and do any include a change-of-control clause?

faq.question: Can Prosperify verify a reported financial figure back to its source?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask about any figure and it returns the underlying adjustments and the page each one comes from.

faq.question: Does it handle audit files and due diligence data rooms?
faq.answer: Yes. Search across statements, audit files, management reports and data rooms with access scoped by engagement and client.

faq.question: How is a discrepancy treated?
faq.answer: Prosperify cross-references sources and flags where a figure disagrees with its underlying detail, so you can investigate before reporting.

accounting.sample_question: Does the reported EBITDA match the underlying adjustments in the bridge, and which figures come from non-recurring items?

faq.subtitle: Key answers about sources, security, deployment and document governance with Prosperify.

items.question: Does the AI continuously learn from my data?
items.answer: No. Client documents are not used to train the model. They are used to generate sourced answers inside the agreed project perimeter.

items.question: Where are documents hosted?
items.answer: It depends on the selected model: dedicated cloud, hybrid architecture or local deployment. In cloud mode, hosting runs across eight European cloud providers (including Hetzner, Scaleway, OVH), with the option to bring your own cluster. The perimeter is defined with you around your security and confidentiality constraints.

items.question: How are documents technically protected?
items.answer: Documents are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS). Keys are managed through HashiCorp Vault, with rotation and per-organization derivation, never mixed with the data they protect. Search runs on encrypted vectors: retrieval uses DCPE (distance-comparison-preserving encryption), so similarity matching happens over obfuscated embeddings without your content ever being stored or queried in plaintext.

items.question: Does Prosperify replace experts?
items.answer: No. Prosperify helps automate document search, synthesis, extraction and comparison. Decisions, validation and interpretation remain with business experts.

items.question: How are answers verified?
items.answer: Answers are generated from selected document excerpts and linked back to the sources used. Insufficiently supported statements can be surfaced to support human review.

items.question: Can access be limited by role, data store or confidentiality level?
items.answer: Yes. Access is governed by role, data store and confidentiality level, with authentication via SSO (Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta, Keycloak). Out-of-scope operations are refused according to configured rules.

items.question: Do we need to rebuild the information system?
items.answer: No. Prosperify can be added as a document intelligence layer on top of existing systems. Integration can start with one data store and one business use case before expanding.

items.question: Which formats are supported?
items.answer: Prosperify is designed for structured and unstructured documents, including PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, JSON and other business formats depending on project scope.

items.question: Which deployment modes are possible?
items.answer: Three approaches are possible: dedicated cloud, hybrid or local. The choice depends on confidentiality level, infrastructure constraints and sovereignty needs.

items.question: Which professions does Prosperify cover?
items.answer: Legal, accounting/finance and medical/health. The same research agent, tailored to how each field reads its documents: contracts and clauses, financial statements and deal files, protocols and regulatory files.
